title: Zero-gravity bonding of ceramic to metal with human DNA, used in medical implants

tellings.quote: And then they figured out in zero gravity how to to bond ceramic to metal. And then they were able to put human DNA into the ceramic.

plain: Scientists are said to have worked out how to bond ceramic to metal in zero gravity, in space with NASA, the US space agency, and then to put human DNA into the ceramic for use in medical implants. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, repeats this from what someone told him: "they figured out in zero gravity how to bond ceramic to metal." He tells it as an example of advanced technology said to have come out of secret work.
